description: Commodity Heat Check — all 11 commodity symbols simultaneously scored RED / YELLOW / GREEN. Fast single-call scan of the full commodity universe: WHEAT, CORN, SOYB, COFFEE, COCOA, COTTON, SUGAR, WTI, NG, COPPER, LUMBER. Returns per-symbol climate stress signal, risk driver, and urgency label. Ideal for daily monitoring, dashboard widgets, and as a triage step before calling forecast.commodity_outlook for detail on flagged symbols. Free.
name: forecast.heat_check

summary.description: Plain-language summary of which markets are most stressed.

symbols.description: Per-symbol: symbol, signal (RED/YELLOW/GREEN), urgency, primaryDriver, score.
